artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
Cure for Sanity is the third studio album by English band Pop Will Eat Itself, released on 22 October 1990 by RCA Records. Musically, the album blends electronic and rock elements, continuing the band's signature fusion of alternative rock with electronic sampling and industrial influences. This release further developed their sound with a mix of energetic beats, layered samples, and rock instrumentation, reflecting the evolving landscape of early 1990s alternative music.

In the context of the band's discography, Cure for Sanity followed their earlier work on RCA and marked a period of increasing experimentation and commercial visibility. The album reached number 33 on the UK Albums Chart and remained there for two weeks, demonstrating moderate commercial success. It spawned singles such as "Touched by the Hand of Cicciolina," which charted in the UK Singles Chart, reinforcing the band's presence in the alternative scene at the time. The album was later re-released in 1991 with additional tracks, maintaining its relevance and appeal among fans.

Critically, Cure for Sanity was recognized for its innovative blend of electronic and rock styles, contributing to Pop Will Eat Itself's reputation as pioneers in merging genres during this era. While not a major commercial breakthrough, the album solidified their cult status and influenced subsequent alternative and electronic rock acts.
